episode_title: SCOTUS After the Midterms, Social Media Lawsuit, Life Under Economic Pressure in Cuba
script_en: SCOTUS After the Midterms, Social Media Lawsuit, Life Under Economic Pressure in Cuba.
What the big win for Democrats in the midterm elections means for the Supreme Court and lower courts.
Big tech companies sue California to block the enforcement of a state law meant to protect children from getting addicted to social media.
Life in Cuba gets harder as the United States increases economic pressure on the island country.
